label: The Summer Guest
summary: You arrive at Ashcombe House for the summer and are mistaken, on the doorstep, for someone the family has been expecting for years.
title: The Summer Guest
description: The housekeeper calls you by a name that is not yours, and before you can correct her, the whole household has heard it.

chapterOutlines.title: A Case of Mistaken Identity
chapterOutlines.outline: Arrive, be mistaken for the long-awaited guest, decide whether to say so.

chapterOutlines.title: Tennis and Lies
chapterOutlines.outline: Keep the story straight through a day of games and questions.

chapterOutlines.title: The Midsummer Ball
chapterOutlines.outline: The real guest may arrive tonight.

scene.location: The front steps of Ashcombe House
scene.summary: A hot June afternoon. Your luggage is already being carried in, and the housekeeper has just welcomed you by the wrong name.

openThreads: Who is the guest everyone was expecting, and why have they never come?

npcs.name: Celia Ashcombe
npcs.description: Bored by the season, sharper than anyone gives her credit for, and the only one who looks at you as if she knows.
personality: kind when no one is watching
goals: Escape another summer of being matched with dull suitors
abilities: Remembers everything anyone says at dinner
